title: Finland – Diagnostic devices – Diffuusiokapasiteetti/Spirometrialaitteistot
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Etelä-Savon hyvinvointialueen (Eloisa) Mikkelin keskussairaalaan tuleva diffuusiokapasiteetti-/spirometrialaitteisto (1 kpl) sekä laitekohtaiset kulutustarvikkeet, ohjelmisto, lisenssit ja huoltopalvelu. Hankinnassa on lisäksi optio kahdelle (2) vastaavanlaiselle laitekokonaisuudelle (diffuusiokapasiteetti-/spirometrialaitteistot) sekä yhdelle (1) spirometrialaitteistolle. Eloisa päättää mahdollisten optioiden hankkimisesta vuoden 2028 loppuun mennessä. Sopimuskausi alkaa sopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta. Sopimus allekirjoitetaan mahdollisimman pian lainvoimaisen päätöksen jälkeen. Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Laitteen tulee soveltua diffuusiokapasiteetin mittaamiseen ja spirometriatutkimusten tekemiseen. Spirometria ja diffuusiokapasiteetti ovat keskeisiä keuhkojen toimintakokeita. Spirometrialla mitataan keuhkojen tilavuutta ja ilman virtausta, mikä auttaa tunnistamaan ahtauttavat (esim. astma, COPD) tai rajoittavat keuhkosairaudet. Diffuusiokapasiteetti mittaa kaasujen siirtymistä keuhkorakkuloista vereen, ja sitä käytetään keuhkokudoksen sairauksien (esim. fibroosi) arvioinnissa. Laitteella tulee pystyä tekemään spirometria ja bronkodilataatiokoe, diffuusiokoe hengityslihasvoiman mittaus sekä SNIP. Pyydettäessä tarjoaja toimittaa kustannuksellaan tarjotun laitteistokokonaisuuden koekäyttöön Mikkelin keskussairaalalle. Tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan ehdollisena optioiden osalta: optioiden hankinnat voidaan toteuttaa, mikäli hankinnoille varatut investointimäärärahat hyväksytään.

title: Sole Source Justification JA-2026-03-8045 - TSA STIP SETA Bridge Support
description: This sole-source justification provides authority to award a task order on the basis of other than full and open competition for Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) support services. The contractor will perform SETA services to assist the SC Security Technology Integration Program (STIP) in system development and operations and maintenance (O&M). This includes providing technical guidance throughout the acquisition lifecycle and systems engineering life cycle (SELC), reviewing open architecture (OA), System of Systems (SoS), design documentation, and supporting risk management activities. The contractor will also assist in developing and maintaining documentation, reviewing operational processes for compliance and efficiency, supporting incident response and troubleshooting, and execution of major initiatives within STIP and related security technology efforts. These services will ensure accurate reporting and device connectivity to TSANetwork (TSANet) via the Security Technology Information eXchange (STIX) for alarm counts and throughput data. The contractor will validate the accuracy and integrity of system-generated reports, support improvements to reporting tools, and ensure compliance with Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and TSA data standards. Additionally, the contractor will review and validate device integration with TSANet, verify data transmission protocols, and assist in resolving connectivity issues to ensure reliable data collection and aggregation. STIP is the interface of Secure Flight (SF), Credential Authentication Technology CAT 2 (CAT-2), enhanced metal detectors (EMDs), and connectivity of other Transportation Security Equipment (TSE). These TSEs enhance the capabilities necessary to sustain TSA�s mission-critical operations, equip the frontline, and safeguard the traveling public. STIP provides the connection between TSEs located in airports and the TSANet for sharing of mission, and operational and maintenance data. Specifically, STIP enables network connectivity for exchanging the near-real time passenger vetting status of more than 1.7 million passengers daily between TSA�s SF system and over 2,100 CAT / CAT-2 units deployed at airports across the country. Without a STIP connection, that data cannot be shared with the checkpoints and data is performed manually by Transportation Security Officers (TSOs) on an hourly basis. SETA support services are paramount to providing technical monitoring of the STIP platform including analysis of vulnerabilities to the system and identification of process improvements and efficiencies to current and continuous operational changes. Only B&B can provide the required continuity of services with the highest level of confidence while maintaining support for active and time-sensitive SC initiatives and operations and maintenance services. These SC initiatives include ensuring successful management and completion of Advanced Imaging Technology (AIT) connectivity, Security Technology Information eXchange (STIX) connectivity, and operational utility evaluation (OUE) activities by November 2026; ensuring successful management and completion of the STIP database server migration to Windows Server 19 by January 2027; ensuring successful completion and operational readiness of the Data Center 15 (DC15) development lab by March 2027; and ensuring successful management and completion of ongoing STIP engineering change requests (ECRs), enhancements, and O&M. +++++++++++++

Diffuusiokapasiteetti mittaa kaasujen siirtymistä keuhkorakkuloista vereen, ja sitä käytetään keuhkokudoksen sairauksien (esim. fibroosi) arvioinnissa. Laitteella tulee pystyä tekemään spirometria ja bronkodilataatiokoe, diffuusiokoe hengityslihasvoiman mittaus sekä SNIP. title: Market Research for Specialized Flight Test and Evaluation Training Services
description: 1. Purpose The Department of War (DoW) is conducting market research to identify interested and capable businesses that can provide test pilot training in support of the US Air Force Security Assistance Training (AFSAT) squadron. This Sources Sought Notice is issued for market research and planning purposes only. It does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quote, commitment by the Government, or promise to issue a solicitation in the future. The Government will not reimburse any costs associated with preparation or submission of a response. Responses will be used to assess market capability, commercial availability, acquisition alternatives, and the availability of small-business concerns capable of performing the anticipated requirement as a prime contractor. 2. Anticipated Requirement and Preliminary Training Demand The Government is seeking information from firms capable of providing flight-training services that may include: Flight instruction for test pilot training Ground-school instruction and courseware; Instructor pilots and, if applicable, simulator instructors; Aircraft, simulators, training devices, facilities, equipment, and associated support; Student scheduling, training administration, and records management; Evaluation, qualification, proficiency, or recurrent-training events; Safety management, quality assurance, and accident/incident reporting processes; Training status, student performance, and completion reporting; and Other associated services that are necessary to deliver the required training outcomes. 3. Required Course Offerings and Course-Specific Response Requirements Interested parties must demonstrate the capability to provide the entirety of the following courses and specialized curricula: Category Course Title Duration / Certification Professional Traditional Professional Course (NATO STANAG 4578 / SETP-Compliant Flight Test Qualification; EASA Part-FCL.820 Approved Category 1 (Lead Flight Test) and Category 2 Flight Test Rating Training via an authorized EASA Approved Training Organization (ATO)) 50 Weeks Professional Standard EASA Cat 1 Certified 31 Weeks Professional Traditional EASA Category 2 Course 20 Weeks Professional Performance and Flying Qualities Professional Course 26 Weeks Professional System Professional Course 26 Weeks Unmanned Systems UAV Systems Testing Specialized Short & Specialized Pre-TPS Course Short Course Short & Specialized Helmet Mounted Display (HMD) and Night Vision Goggle (NVG) Testing Short Course Short & Specialized Introduction to Systems Testing Short Course Short & Specialized Operational Test and Evaluation (OT&E) Course Short Course Short & Specialized EASA Approved Training Organization Upset Prevention and Recovery Training (UPRT) Short Course Short & Specialized Spin Training Course Short Course Short & Specialized Crew Resource Management for Flight Testers Short Course 4. Anticipated Mandatory Institutional Accreditations, Approvals, and Credentials The Government anticipates that a future solicitation may require the successful contractor to maintain the following institutional accreditations, approvals, and credentials. Respondents shall provide verifiable documentation of their current status, including the issuing organization, approval/accreditation number where applicable, scope, effective date, expiration date, and any pending renewal or limitation. Mandatory accreditations may be satisfied by the prime contractor, a joint venture partner, or a designated and formal subcontractor/teaming partner at time of proposal submission/prior to contract performance. 4.1 Collegiate Accreditation Accreditation as a degree-granting institution by an accrediting agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education, such as the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC), or another recognized accrediting agency. 4.2 Engineering-Program Accreditation Accreditation by the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET) for a relevant Master of Science program. Response requested: Identify the applicable graduate program, ABET-accreditation status, and relationship of that program to the flight-test curriculum. 4.3 European Union Aviation Safety Agency Approval Status as a European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) Approved Training Organization (ATO) approved to provide flight-test training for issuance of EASA Category 1 and Category 2 flight-test ratings, as applicable to the proposed courses. Response requested: Provide the ATO approval and scope of privileges and identify the specific courses that support EASA Category 1 and/or Category 2 flight-test ratings. EASA rules describe the authority of approved training organizations to provide training for Category 1 or 2 flight-test ratings, with potential extension for other flight-test categories and personnel under specified conditions. 4.4 Federal Aviation Administration Air Agency Certificate An active Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Air Agency Certificate under Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) Part 141 - Pilot Schools, including the applicable approval for pilot special preparation under Appendix K. Response requested: Provide the certificate number, current status, applicable approved courses, and any limitations relevant to the anticipated requirement. Preliminary training demand: Estimated students annually: 10-15 Estimated classes/training iterations annually: 10 Estimated flight hours, sorties, simulator hours, or other workload metric: Integrated live-fly, variable-stability, and synthetic simulation environment Anticipated period of performance: 5 years Anticipated start date: 1 Oct 2027 All quantities and dates are estimates for market research purposes and may change. For each course, respondents shall provide: A course description and current syllabus or curriculum summary; The basis for any stated certification, rating, or credential awarded upon course completion; Course duration, format, location, and maximum student capacity; Instructor qualifications and available aircraft, simulators, test assets, laboratories, and other instructional resources; Any prerequisites, minimum student qualifications, medical requirements, or flight-hour requirements; The number of times the course has been delivered within the preceding [insert timeframe]; and Any limitations, lead times, or dependencies affecting ability to provide the course. 5. Capability Statement Content Interested firms should submit a capability statement of no more than 10 pages, excluding cover page and attachments. The capability statement should include: Company information Legal business name UEI and CAGE code Business address Website, if available Primary business point of contact, using business contact information Proposed NAICS code(s) Business size and socioeconomic status under the proposed NAICS code Technical Capability and Past Performance Provide the course-specific capability information required by Section 3 and the accreditation, approval, and credential documentation required by Section 4. In addition, provide up to 3 examples of recent (last 3 years) and relevant (proven track record of similar work that demonstrates ability to deliver specified courses and services and possesses required accreditations) past performance including customer type, period of performance, scope, training volume, and complexity. Acquisition and Market Feedback Address whether the requirement is commercially available without material modification; recommended contract or ordering structure; principal cost, schedule, mobilization, and performance risks; and recommended outcome-based performance measures. B) Την προμήθεια των ανταλλακτικών αρχικής υποστήριξης, όπως αναλυτικά περιλαμβάνονται στο συνημμένο στο έντυπο οικονομικής προσφοράς «Πίνακας Ανταλλακτικών Αρχικής Υποστήριξης». description: Die Verwaltungsdirektion des WDR beabsichtigt, einen Rahmenvertrag über Beratungs-, Konzeptions- und fachliche Begleitleistungen für das Projekt "Business Warehouse" abzuschließen. Das Vorhaben ist als mehrjähriges Transformations- und Umsetzungsprojekt angelegt. Ziel des Projekts ist die fachliche Konzeption und schrittweise Einführung eines integrierten Steuerungsmodells, das strategische Planung, Mittelallokation, Portfolio- und Performancebetrachtung sowie Transparenz über Ressourcen, Kosten und Wirkung miteinander verknüpft. Das Vorhaben dient damit der Weiterentwicklung der unternehmensweiten Steuerungsfähigkeit des WDR. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet das Vorhaben von der Feinkonzeption über die Umsetzungsphase bis zur Produktivsetzung und dem Übergang in den Regelbetrieb. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind ausschließlich Beratungsleistungen, die fachliche Konzeption sowie die fachliche Begleitung des Projekts über alle Projektphasen hinweg. Erwartet wird auch die fachliche Konzeption und Begleitung der technischen Umsetzung sowie die Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare Prozess-, Daten- und Systemanforderungen. Die technische Implementierung und Softwareentwicklung selbst sind nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung. Der Auftrag wird als Rahmenvertrag ohne Abnahmeverpflichtung ausgeschrieben. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 27 Monate ab Leistungsbeginn; der WDR erhält die Option, den Ver-trag einmalig um ein weiteres Jahr zu verlängern. Die geschätzte Abrufmenge beträgt ca. 350 Personentage; die Höchstmenge beträgt 400 Personentage. Mit Erreichen der Höchstmenge endet die Möglichkeit weiterer Abrufe aus dem Rahmenvertrag.
